```artifact
Feature: Patient Management

  Scenario: Register a new Patient
    Given a new patient with name "John" and date of birth "1990-01-01"
    When I register the patient
    Then the patient is registered successfully

  Scenario: View and Update the details of an existing Patient
    Given a patient with name "Jane" and date of birth "1995-06-01" is already registered
    When I view the patient's details
    And I update the patient's details
    Then the patient's details are updated successfully

  Scenario: Delete the Patient Details
    Given a patient with name "Bob" and date of birth "1980-03-01" is already registered
    And there is a consultation request for the patient within the last 3 years
    When I try to delete the patient's details
    Then the deletion is not allowed due to pending consultation request

  Scenario: Rollback by a month
    Given a patient with name "Alice" and date of birth "1992-01-01" is already registered
    When I rollback the system by a month
    Then the system is rolled back successfully

  Scenario: Restore the back-up
    Given a back-up of the system is available
    When I restore the back-up on a dummy production system
    Then the back-up is restored successfully

  Scenario: Purge the dummy production database
    Given a dummy production database is available
    When I purge the database
    Then the database is purged successfully

  Scenario: Maintain the back-up in a fire proof cabinet
    Given a fire proof cabinet is available in Mangalore HQ
    When I store the back-up in the cabinet
    Then the back-up is stored successfully

  Scenario Outline: Medicines are delivered as prescribed by the doctor (offline)
    Given a patient with name "<patient_name>" and date of birth "<date_of_birth>" is already registered
    And a doctor has prescribed medicines for the patient
    When I deliver the medicines to the patient
    Then the medicines are delivered successfully
    Examples:
      | patient_name | date_of_birth |
      | John         | 1990-01-01     |
      | Jane         | 1995-06-01     |
      | Bob          | 1980-03-01     |
      | Alice        | 1992-01-01     |

  Scenario Outline: View and Update the details of an existing Patient (latest details only)
    Given a patient with name "<patient_name>" and date of birth "<date_of_birth>" is already registered
    When I view the patient's details
    And I update the patient's details
    Then the patient's details are updated successfully
    Examples:
      | patient_name | date_of_birth |
      | John         | 1990-01-01     |
      | Jane         | 1995-06-01     |
      | Bob          | 1980-03-01     |
      | Alice        | 1992-01-01     |

  Scenario Outline: Delete the Patient Details (pending consultation request)
    Given a patient with name "<patient_name>" and date of birth "<date_of_birth>" is already registered
    And there is a consultation request for the patient within the last 3 years
    When I try to delete the patient's details
    Then the deletion is not allowed due to pending consultation request
    Examples:
      | patient_name | date_of_birth |
      | John         | 1990-01-01     |
      | Jane         | 1995-06-01     |
      | Bob          | 1980-03-01     |
      | Alice        | 1992-01-01     |

  Scenario Outline: Rollback by a month (boundary tests)
    Given a patient with name "<patient_name>" and date of birth "<date_of_birth>" is already registered
    When I rollback the system by a month
    Then the system is rolled back successfully
    Examples:
      | patient_name | date_of_birth |
      | John         | 1990-01-01     |
      | Jane         | 1995-06-01     |
      | Bob          | 1980-03-01     |
      | Alice        | 1992-01-01     |

  Scenario Outline: Restore the back-up (boundary tests)
    Given a back-up of the system is available
    When I restore the back-up on a dummy production system
    Then the back-up is restored successfully
    Examples:
      | patient_name | date_of_birth |
      | John         | 1990-01-01     |
      | Jane         | 1995-06-01     |
      | Bob          | 1980-03-01     |
      | Alice        | 1992-01-01     |

  Scenario Outline: Purge the dummy production database (boundary tests)
    Given a dummy production database is available
    When I purge the database
    Then the database is purged successfully
    Examples:
      | patient_name | date_of_birth |
      | John         | 1990-01-01     |
      | Jane         | 1995-06-01     |
      | Bob          | 1980-03-01     |
      | Alice        | 1992-01-01     |

  Scenario Outline: Maintain the back-up in a fire proof cabinet (boundary tests)
    Given a fire proof cabinet is available in Mangalore HQ
    When I store the back-up in the cabinet
    Then the back-up is stored successfully
    Examples:
      | patient_name | date_of_birth |
      | John         | 1990-01-01     |
      | Jane         | 1995-06-01     |
      | Bob          | 1980-03-01     |
      | Alice        | 1992-01-01     |

  Scenario: Duplicate patient registration
    Given a patient with name "John" and date of birth "1990-01-01" is already registered
    When I try to register the patient again
    Then the registration is not allowed due to duplicate patient

  Scenario: Exact 3-year boundary for pending consultation request
    Given a patient with name "John" and date of birth "1990-01-01" is already registered
    And there is a consultation request for the patient exactly 3 years ago
    When I try to delete the patient's details
    Then the deletion is not allowed due to pending consultation request

  Scenario: 1 day before/after rollback boundary
    Given a patient with name "John" and date of birth "1990-01-01" is already registered
    When I rollback the system by 1 day
    Then the system is rolled back successfully

  Scenario: 1 day before/after restore boundary
    Given a back-up of the system is available
    When I restore the back-up on a dummy production system
    Then the back-up is restored successfully

  Scenario: 1 day before/after purge boundary
    Given a dummy production database is available
    When I purge the database
    Then the database is purged successfully

  Scenario: 1 day before/after store boundary
    Given a fire proof cabinet is available in Mangalore HQ
    When I store the back-up in the cabinet
    Then the back-up is stored successfully
```
